report.explanation: All checkout observations are healthy: 200 statuses, 63-94ms durations, p95 ~98ms, zero 502s, and every trace span (redis, inventory, payment, postgres) completes with ok. No evidence supports any taxonomy cause; the alert itself shows no fault. Handing off rather than asserting an unsupported root cause.
missing_evidence: Sustained latency or error telemetry on /v1/checkout exceeding an SLO threshold
Dependency-level metrics (redis/postgres/payment) showing timeouts or saturation
Logs or traces with non-ok status, errors, or retries during the incident window
Baseline latency distribution to establish whether observed durations are anomalous
